title: Existing intelligent audit list loads with correct phase status per audit
steps: GET /api/intelligent-audit/framework/:frameworkId for a project with at least one in-progress audit
expectedResult: Each audit in the list shows its correct current phase (1, 2, or 3) and completion state.

title: Phase 2 controls endpoint returns the same controls as were confirmed in Phase 1's CFRS section
steps: Complete Phase 1 CFRS + strategic + tactical sections for an audit
expectedResult: Phase 2's control list is consistent with what Phase 1 generated — no silently dropped or duplicated controls.

title: Retry tactical generation does not duplicate previously generated tactical questions
steps: Trigger retry-tactical on an audit that already has tactical questions generated
expectedResult: The retried generation replaces (not appends to) the existing tactical question set.

title: Compliance change decision endpoint reflects the decision on next fetch
steps: POST a decision (accept/reject) on a pending compliance change
GET the same compliance change by ID
expectedResult: The fetched record reflects the decision just made, not the prior pending state.

title: Phase 3 findings for a control load without error after Phase 3 initialization
expectedResult: Returns 200 with an empty or populated findings array, no 500 error on a freshly initialized phase.
